sections.identityHint: How this namespace is referenced in code, logs, and the audit trail.
sections.validationHint: Constraints applied at upload time before an asset is accepted.
sections.lifecycleHint: Retention, EXIF handling, and immutability rules.
sections.servingHint: How rendered assets are delivered to clients.
sections.advancedHint: Optional JSON for moderation, required metadata, and retry policy.

fields.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Must start and end with a letter or digit.
fields.allowedMimeTypesHelp: Comma-separated list of MIME types, e.g. image/jpeg, image/png
fields.storageBindingHelp: Pick the storage binding where uploaded objects land. Manage bindings under System.
fields.maxFileSizeBytesHelp: Maximum upload size in bytes. Defaults to 50 MiB (52,428,800).
fields.virusScanRequiredHelp: Reject uploads if the antivirus scanner is unreachable.
fields.retentionDaysHelp: Days to retain assets after upload. Leave empty for indefinite retention.
fields.retentionModeHelp: delete: hard-delete after retention. archive: keep with an archived marker. none: no automatic action.
fields.exifHandlingHelp: strip removes EXIF on store. preserve keeps it. extract_then_strip stores metadata server-side, then strips.
fields.immutableHelp: Once uploaded, assets cannot be replaced or edited in place.
fields.servingModeHelp: public: anyone can fetch. signed: short-lived pre-signed URLs only. proxied: every request streams through the app.
fields.signedUrlTtlSecondsHelp: How long a single signed URL stays valid, in seconds.
fields.signedUrlBucketSizeHelp: Cache window for batched signed-URL issuance, in seconds.
fields.contentModerationHelp: JSON config for moderation thresholds. Leave empty to disable.
fields.requiredMetadataSchemaHelp: JSON Schema describing metadata fields required at upload. Leave empty for none.
fields.retryConfigHelp: JSON config for the asset-upload retry policy. Leave empty to use defaults.

retentionModeHints.delete: Delete the asset and its renditions when retention expires.
retentionModeHints.archive: Mark archived but keep the bytes; never serve again unless restored.
retentionModeHints.none: No automatic action — assets live indefinitely.

exifHandlingHints.strip: Remove all EXIF data on upload. Smallest object, no metadata.
exifHandlingHints.preserve: Keep all EXIF metadata as the camera wrote it.
exifHandlingHints.extract_then_strip: Extract EXIF into the database, then strip from the stored bytes.

servingModeHints.public: Anyone with the URL can fetch — no signature required.
servingModeHints.signed: Issue short-lived pre-signed URLs to authorized callers.
servingModeHints.proxied: All requests stream through the application; nothing served direct from storage.
